verses.original: הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ וְכָל־ צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šā·ma·yim wə·hā·’ā·reṣ way·ḵul·lū wə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā·’ām
verses.literal: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י בַּיּ֣וֹם אֱלֹהִים֙ וַיְכַ֤ל מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י בַּיּ֣וֹם וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bay·yō·wm ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ḵal mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bay·yō·wm way·yiš·bōṯ mik·kāl mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And by the seventh day God had finished the work - He had been doing so on [that] day He rested from all His work . . . . . .

verses.original: אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י י֣וֹם וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ בָּרָ֥א אֲשֶׁר־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·ḇā·reḵ haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yō·wm way·qad·dêš ’ō·ṯōw kî ḇōw šā·ḇaṯ mik·kāl mə·laḵ·tōw bā·rā ’ă·šer- ’ĕ·lō·hîm la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then God - blessed the seventh day and sanctified it because on [that day] He rested from all the work of creation that [He] had accomplished

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים עֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ṯō·wl·ḏō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·hā·’ā·reṣ bə·hib·bā·rə·’ām bə·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ă·śō·wṯ ’e·reṣ wə·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: This [is] the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created in the day that the LORD God made [them] . . .

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכָל־ עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַ֔יִן וְאָדָ֣ם לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl śî·aḥ haś·śā·ḏeh ṭe·rem yih·yeh ḇā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl ‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh ṭe·rem yiṣ·māḥ kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō him·ṭîr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ’a·yin wə·’ā·ḏām la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Now [no] shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth nor had any plant of the field - sprouted for the LORD God had not [yet] sent rain upon the earth and [there was] no man to cultivate - the ground

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ פְּנֵֽי־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êḏ ya·‘ă·leh min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- kāl- pə·nê- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: But springs welled up from the earth and watered - the whole surface of the ground

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ וַיִּיצֶר֩ הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים בְּאַפָּ֖יו הָֽאָדָ֖ם וַֽיְהִ֥י חַיָּֽה׃ לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·yî·ṣer hā·’ā·ḏām ‘ā·p̄ār min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh way·yip·paḥ niš·maṯ ḥay·yîm bə·’ap·pāw hā·’ā·ḏām way·hî ḥay·yāh lə·ne·p̄eš
verses.literal: Then the LORD God - formed man [from] the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils and the man became a living being

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים וַיִּטַּ֞ע גַּן־ בְעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־ וַיָּ֣שֶׂם הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiṭ·ṭa‘ gan- bə·‘ê·ḏen miq·qe·ḏem šām ’eṯ- way·yā·śem hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer yā·ṣār
verses.literal: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden in the east where - He placed the man - He had formed

verses.original: מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וַיַּצְמַ֞ח כָּל־ עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yaṣ·maḥ kāl- ‘êṣ neḥ·māḏ lə·mar·’eh wə·ṭō·wḇ lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl bə·ṯō·wḵ hag·gān wə·‘êṣ ha·ḥay·yîm wə·‘êṣ had·da·‘aṯ ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘
verses.literal: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food And in the middle of the garden [were] the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil

verses.original: וְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־ הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nå̄·hå̄r yō·ṣê mê·‘ê·ḏen lə·haš·qō·wṯ ’eṯ- hag·gān ū·miš·šām yip·pā·rêḏ wə·hā·yāh lə·’ar·bā·‘āh rā·šîm
verses.literal: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water - the garden and from there it branched into . . . four headwaters

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם הָֽאֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ pî·šō·wn hū has·sō·ḇêḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ ha·ḥă·wî·lāh ’ă·šer- šām haz·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: The name of the first [river] [is] the Pishon it winds through - the whole land of Havilah where there [is] gold

verses.original: וּֽזֲהַ֛ב הַהִ֖וא הָאָ֥רֶץ ט֑וֹב הַבְּדֹ֖לַח וְאֶ֥בֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃ שָׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ū·ză·haḇ ha·hi·w hā·’ā·reṣ ṭō·wḇ hab·bə·ḏō·laḥ wə·’e·ḇen haš·šō·ham šām
verses.literal: And the gold of that land [is] pure [and] bdellium vvv and onyx [are found] there

verses.original: וְשֵֽׁם־ הַשֵּׁנִ֖י הַנָּהָ֥ר גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm- haš·šê·nî han·nā·hār gî·ḥō·wn hū has·sō·w·ḇêḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ kūš
verses.literal: The name of the second river [is] the Gihon it winds through - the whole land of Cush

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ הַנָּהָ֤ר חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽהֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר הָֽרְבִיעִ֖י וְהַנָּהָ֥ר ה֥וּא פְרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm haš·šə·lî·šî han·nā·hār ḥid·de·qel hū ha·hō·lêḵ qiḏ·maṯ ’aš·šūr hā·rə·ḇî·‘î wə·han·nā·hār hū p̄ə·rāṯ
verses.literal: The name of the third river [is] the Tigris it runs along the east side of Assyria And the fourth river [is the] Euphrates

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֛ח הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּנִּחֵ֣הוּ בְגַן־ עֵ֔דֶן לְעָבְדָ֖הּ וּלְשָׁמְרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ hā·’ā·ḏām way·yan·ni·ḥê·hū ḇə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏāh ū·lə·šā·mə·rāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD God - took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־ וַיְצַו֙ הָֽאָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל׃ מִכֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ־ הַגָּ֖ן
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- way·ṣaw hā·’ā·ḏām lê·mōr ’ā·ḵōl tō·ḵêl mik·kōl ‘êṣ- hag·gān
verses.literal: And the LORD God . . . commanded [him] - You may eat freely . . . from every tree of the garden

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֙עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכָלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵal mim·men·nū ū·mê·‘êṣ had·da·‘aṯ ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘ kî bə·yō·wm ’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵā mim·men·nū mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ
verses.literal: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil for in the day that you eat of it you will surely die . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹא־ ט֛וֹב הָֽאָדָ֖ם הֱי֥וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־ לּ֥וֹ כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃ עֵ֖זֶר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lō- ṭō·wḇ hā·’ā·ḏām hĕ·yō·wṯ lə·ḇad·dōw ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lō kə·neḡ·dōw ‘ê·zer
verses.literal: The LORD God also said [It is] not good for the man to be alone I will make for him a suitable helper

verses.original: מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים וַיִּצֶר֩ כָּל־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־ יִּקְרָא־ ל֑וֹ וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָֽאָדָ֛ם יִקְרָא־ ל֧וֹ חַיָּ֖ה נֶ֥פֶשׁ ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yi·ṣer kāl- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim way·yā·ḇê ’el- hā·’ā·ḏām lir·’ō·wṯ mah- yiq·rā- lōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·’ā·ḏām yiq·rā- lōw ḥay·yāh ne·p̄eš hū šə·mōw
verses.literal: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field - and every bird of the air and He brought [them] to the man to see what he would name . . . each one - And whatever the man called . . . each living creature that [was] its name

verses.original: הָֽאָדָ֜ם וַיִּקְרָ֨א שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּלְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּלְאָדָ֕ם לֹֽא־ כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃ עֵ֖זֶר מָצָ֥א
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ḏām way·yiq·rā šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḵāl hab·bə·hê·māh ū·lə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ū·lə·’ā·ḏām lō- kə·neḡ·dōw ‘ê·zer mā·ṣā
verses.literal: The man gave names to all the livestock to the birds of the air and to every beast of the field But for Adam no suitable helper was found

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ וַיַּפֵּל֩ הָאָדָ֖ם עַל־ תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה וַיִּישָׁ֑ן וַיִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִצַּלְעֹתָ֔יו וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר תַּחְתֶּֽנָּה׃ בָּשָׂ֖ר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yap·pêl hā·’ā·ḏām ‘al- tar·dê·māh way·yî·šān way·yiq·qaḥ ’a·ḥaṯ miṣ·ṣal·‘ō·ṯāw way·yis·gōr taḥ·ten·nāh bā·śār
verses.literal: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep and while he slept He took one of [the man’s] ribs and closed up the area with flesh

verses.original: הַצֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ אֶֽת־ לָקַ֥ח מִן־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם וַיִּבֶן֩ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיְבִאֶ֖הָ אֶל־ הָֽאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣê·lā‘ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- lā·qaḥ min- hā·’ā·ḏām way·yi·ḇen lə·’iš·šāh way·ḇi·’e·hā ’el- hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: And from the rib that the LORD God - had taken from the man He made a woman and brought her to [him]

verses.original: הָֽאָדָם֒ וַיֹּאמֶר֮ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ זֹּֽאת׃ לֻֽקֳחָה־
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ḏām way·yō·mer zōṯ hap·pa·‘am ‘e·ṣem mê·‘ă·ṣā·may ū·ḇā·śār mib·bə·śā·rî lə·zōṯ yiq·qā·rê ’iš·šāh kî mê·’îš zōṯ lu·qo·ḥāh-
verses.literal: And the man said This [is] now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh she shall be called woman for out of man she was taken

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ יַֽעֲזָב־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־ אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ אֶחָֽד׃ לְבָשָׂ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’îš ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·zāḇ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- ’im·mōw wə·ḏā·ḇaq bə·’iš·tōw wə·hā·yū ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḇā·śār
verses.literal: For this reason a man - will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife and they will become one flesh

verses.original: הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים וְלֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ḏām wə·’iš·tōw way·yih·yū šə·nê·hem ‘ă·rūm·mîm wə·lō yiṯ·bō·šā·šū
verses.literal: And the man and his wife were both naked and they were not ashamed
